Lemongrass Vinegar
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, February 12, 2010 - 5:36pm

Ingredients




3 Lemongrass stalks
2 cups Rice vinegar

Preparation

1 Slice thin the bottom 8 inches of the lemongrass stalks. Put the sliced lemongrass in a very clean 1-quart glass jar, and bruise it with a wooden spoon. Add the vinegar and let the mixture steep, covered with the lid, in a cool dark place for at least 4 days and up to 2 weeks, depending on the strength desired. 2 Strain the vinegar through a fine sieve into a glass pitcher, discarding the lemongrass slices, pour it into 2 very clean 1/2-pint glass jars, and seal the jars with the lids. 3 This recipe yields 2 cups flavored vinegar.
